Power residues and n-th roots modulo m

Source: R/ntheory.R
is_nthpow_residue.Rd

is_nthpow_residue(a, n, m) tests whether x^n = a (mod m) has a solution, and nthroot_mod(a, n, p) returns the smallest solution, every solution with all_roots = TRUE, or NULL (an empty vector) when there is none.

Usage

is_nthpow_residue(a, n, m)

nthroot_mod(a, n, p, all_roots = FALSE)

Arguments

a

An integer.

n

Exponent.

m, p

Modulus.

all_roots

Return all roots.

Value

A logical, an integer, a vector or NULL.

Examples

is_nthpow_residue(2, 3, 7)
#> [1] FALSE
nthroot_mod(11, 4, 19)
#> [1] 8
nthroot_mod(68, 3, 109, all_roots = TRUE)
#> [1] 23 32 54
